title: WwJD: This is what Johnny.Decimal was designed for (video)
summary: [Link to YouTube] Managing complex tasks is not just possible, it's easy with Johnny.Decimal.
content:
A 'Working with Johnny.Decimal' video.

Managing complex tasks is not just possible, it's easy with Johnny.Decimal. Everything has a home, and you keep a simple index that lets you find it again, and everything looks the same no matter what app you're using.
